result.question: According to the man of God’s cry against the altar at Bethel, what will be burned upon it?

readings.support: human bones will be burned upon you

assessments.reason: Verse 13:2 explicitly says, “human bones will be burned upon you,” matching the question’s future-burning focus.
“Who burn incense upon you” describes the priests’ current action, while the prophecy of what will be burned in the future is “human bones will be burned upon you.”

result.reason: The passage plainly states that human bones will be burned on the altar, while incense refers to the priests’ present practice.
